name: Mom
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c131855]Frank[/url]'s biological mother. She was a kind woman and an exemplary mother, Frank never lacked anything when she was around. Though she was easily distracted and a bit of a klutz, she made up for it with her kindness, determination, and honest nature.

When Frank was only 4 years old, she was killed by 2 men who attacked her in their home. She originally tried to run to get Frank out after they killed her [url=https://vndb.org/c170813]husband[/url], but she was grabbed and beaten. In her final moments, she noticed Frank and yelled for him to escape. She was stabbed in the back shortly after but Frank miraculously, and somewhat mysteriously, managed to escape.

[In game description]
